privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At DSA Finance, we prioritize the protection of your personal and financial information. This policy outlines our data collection, usage, encryption, and regulatory compliance practices.
privacy.section1Text: We collect applicant KYC information (name, contact, PAN/Aadhaar references), financial data (monthly income, CIBIL score, obligations), and property/vehicle loan specifications solely for evaluating loan eligibility.
privacy.section2Text: All sensitive transmission is protected via industry-standard TLS encryption, and borrower documents are stored in secure access-controlled cloud repositories.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By accessing DSA Finance platform services, loan calculators, and eligibility evaluators, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
terms.section1Text: DSA Finance functions as an authorized distribution and technology facilitator. Final loan approval, interest rate determination, and disbursals are subject to the underwriting discretion of our partner lending institutions.
